title: Muzaffarnagar steel re-rolling & TMT: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What the business physically is
A re-rolling mill buys iron scrap, melts or reheats it, and rolls TMT bars sold into local construction demand.

## Where value and cash sit
Value sits in brand premium and conversion margin; cash sits in inventory and receivables. **Working capital is the real risk, not the furnace.** Rating reports flag sudden price fluctuations hitting margins [10] and moderately high working-capital needs supported by bank lines [11]. So structure limits against a drawing-power cycle, not peak inventory; if the borrower seeks a limit above the assessed cycle, ask for the last twelve months of stock statements and debtor ageing.

## What has broken locally
Local enforcement is active. Three slag-crushing units were shut down in Muzaffarnagar in late October 2026 [1], and the pollution board raided Rana Steel and Sarvottam Rolling Mill and recommended action in early October 2026 [3]. **Compliance status is now a credit variable, not a paperwork item.** When a proposal lands, check the consent-to-operate validity and any pending pollution-board action; if there is an open raid or closure recommendation, ask for the board's order copy before any limit is renewed.

## Where growth is
State demand is the tailwind: Uttar Pradesh GST collections rose 14.2% Apr-to-date versus India's 6.1% [D], and India-wide IIP for NIC 24 (basic metals) rose 2.4% YoY to August 2026 [D]. Peer results confirm volume pull: Steel Exchange India reported ~₹340 crore Q2 FY27 revenue, up ~45% YoY [6], and Rathi Steel over ₹200 crore, up over 30% YoY [7]. **Pursue branded TMT re-rollers with own rolling capacity and clean consents; avoid slag crushers and units under closure.** Note the ICRA reports on MITC and Captain Steel are from 2024 and 2023 [8][9] and are dated; treat them as background only.

## How to grow safely
Take monthly stock and debtor statements, quarterly GST returns, and a half-yearly pollution-consent copy. **Covenant the consent-to-operate and a minimum interest-coverage floor.** If the borrower cannot produce a current consent, ask for the renewal application and hold disbursement. Sources say little specific to Muzaffarnagar's mill-level finances, so lean on first principles and these peers.
